evaluations.evidence: PP-001: As a moderator, I want to create a new game...
evaluations.rationale: Complementary game-management stories exist (invite PP-002, browse PP-016, view/export transcript PP-017/PP-018/PP-019, delete PP-020), so creation is part of a complete game lifecycle.

evaluations.evidence: PP-002: As a moderator, I want to invite estimators by giving them a URL...
evaluations.rationale: Invitation is supported by joining (PP-029) and limits (PP-028); overall user-join and game lifecycle stories cover the complementary needs.

evaluations.evidence: PP-003: As a moderator, I want to start a round by entering an item...
evaluations.rationale: Starting rounds ties into item selection (PP-005), adding items (PP-006), showing/accepting estimates (PP-009, PP-010, PP-012) and history (PP-039), providing the complementary behaviors needed.

evaluations.evidence: PP-004: As a moderator, I want to see all items we try to estimate this session...
evaluations.rationale: List/view is complemented by add/edit/delete item stories (PP-006, PP-007, PP-008), so item management is complete.

evaluations.evidence: PP-005: As a moderator, I want to select an item to be estimated or re-estimated...
evaluations.rationale: Selecting items to estimate is supported by start-round (PP-003), add/edit/delete (PP-006/PP-007/PP-008) and re-estimate (PP-013), covering required complementary actions.

evaluations.evidence: PP-006: As a moderator, I want to add an item to the list of items to be estimated...
evaluations.rationale: Adding items is paired with edit/delete/list/select stories (PP-007, PP-008, PP-004, PP-005), so CRUD for items is present.

evaluations.evidence: PP-007: As a moderator, I want to edit an item in the list of items to be estimated...
evaluations.rationale: Edit is supported by add/delete/list/select (PP-006, PP-008, PP-004, PP-005), so item lifecycle is complete.

evaluations.evidence: PP-008: As a moderator, I want to delete an item from the list of items to be estimated...
evaluations.rationale: Delete complements add/edit/list/select (PP-006, PP-007, PP-004, PP-005), so no missing complementary capability for item management.

evaluations.evidence: PP-009: As a moderator, I want to show all estimates immediately...
evaluations.rationale: Moderator-controlled reveal complements automatic and end-of-round reveal stories (PP-011, PP-033) and estimate change behavior (PP-034), covering necessary reveal behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: PP-010: As a moderator, I want to accept the average of all estimates...
evaluations.rationale: Accepting estimates complements entering agreed estimate and moving to next item (PP-012) and round management (PP-003), so no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: PP-011: As a moderator, I want to have the "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card...
evaluations.rationale: Auto-fill is supported by manual entry (PP-012), reveal (PP-009/PP-033) and acceptance (PP-010), so complementary behaviours exist.

evaluations.evidence: PP-012: As a moderator, I want to enter the agreed-upon estimate...
evaluations.rationale: Entering agreed estimate complements acceptance, moving on, and re-estimate behavior (PP-010, PP-013), so required complementary capabilities are present.

evaluations.evidence: PP-013: As a moderator, I want to estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again...
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation is supported by item listing and history (PP-004, PP-039) so complementary capabilities for re-estimate are present.

evaluations.evidence: PP-014: As a moderator, I want to import stories from a spreadsheet...
evaluations.rationale: Import is complemented by copy/paste (PP-015) and add/edit item management (PP-006/PP-007), providing necessary complementary functionality.

evaluations.evidence: PP-015: As a moderator, I want to copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet...
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste is an alternative import method and is complemented by add/edit/delete (PP-006/PP-007/PP-008), so no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: PP-016: As a moderator, I want to browse through previous games...
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games pairs with viewing transcripts (PP-017), exporting (PP-018/PP-019), and deleting games (PP-020), covering necessary complementary capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: PP-017: As a moderator, I want to view a transcript of a game...
evaluations.rationale: Transcript viewing is complemented by exports (PP-018/PP-019), browsing (PP-016) and round history/scrolling (PP-039), so no missing complementary requirement.

evaluations.evidence: PP-018: As a moderator, I want to export a transcript of a game as a HTML file...
evaluations.rationale: HTML export complements CSV export (PP-019) and transcript viewing (PP-017), covering export needs.

evaluations.evidence: PP-019: As a moderator, I want to export a transcript of a game as a CSV file...
evaluations.rationale: CSV export complements HTML export (PP-018) and transcript viewing (PP-017), providing complementary export formats.

evaluations.evidence: PP-020: As a moderator, I want to delete a game...
evaluations.rationale: Delete pairs with create (PP-001), browse/view (PP-016/PP-017) and export (PP-018/PP-019), so game lifecycle management is complete.

evaluations.evidence: PP-021: As a moderator, I want to create an account... PP-022: log in; PP-023: change; PP-024: delete; PP-026: password reminder
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is supported by login, change, delete, and password reminder stories (PP-022/PP-023/PP-024/PP-026), covering necessary account-management complements.

evaluations.evidence: PP-022: As a moderator, I want to log in using my account name and password...
evaluations.rationale: Login is complemented by account creation (PP-021), change (PP-023), delete (PP-024) and password reminder (PP-026), so login-related capabilities are complete.

evaluations.evidence: PP-023: As a moderator, I want to change my account details...
evaluations.rationale: Change account details is supported by create/login/delete/password reminder (PP-021/PP-022/PP-024/PP-026), providing the complementary flows.

evaluations.evidence: PP-024: As a moderator, I want to delete my account...
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion complements creation, login and account management (PP-021/PP-022/PP-023) and references game deletion (PP-020), covering required complements.

evaluations.evidence: PP-025: As a moderator, I want to see dates and times in my local timezone...
evaluations.rationale: This non-functional/timezone requirement does not expose a missing complementary capability elsewhere; logs/transcripts (PP-017) and UI stories imply display of timestamps.

evaluations.evidence: PP-026: As a moderator, I want to get a password reminder by email...
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder complements account creation and login (PP-021/PP-022), providing the complementary recovery capability.

evaluations.evidence: PP-027: As a moderator, I want to select whether to have the team estimate with {...} or {...}
evaluations.rationale: Selecting the card set is self-contained and does not require missing complementary capability; estimator/card behaviours are covered elsewhere (PP-040, PP-034).

evaluations.evidence: PP-028: As a moderator, I want to invite up to 15 estimators...
evaluations.rationale: Invitation capacity is supported by invite mechanism (PP-002) and estimator join (PP-029); no missing complementary capability evident.

evaluations.evidence: PP-029: As an estimator, I want to join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for...
evaluations.rationale: Joining via URL matches invitation (PP-002) and estimator UI needs (PP-030 etc.), so complementary join flows are present.

evaluations.evidence: PP-030: As an estimator, I want to see the item we're estimating...
evaluations.rationale: Estimator view of current item is supported by moderator round control (PP-003, PP-005) and participant view stories (PP-031), so no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: PP-031: As an estimator, I want to see all items we will try to estimate this session...
evaluations.rationale: Item overview complements moderator item management (PP-004, PP-006-PP-008) so required capabilities for display and management exist.

evaluations.evidence: PP-032: As a participant, I want to immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator...
evaluations.rationale: Immediate indication is complemented by reveal stories (PP-033), per-round visibility (PP-036) and change behaviour (PP-034), so no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: PP-033: As a participant, I want to be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate...
evaluations.rationale: Synchronized reveal is complemented by moderator override (PP-009), change-until-reveal (PP-034/PP-041) and per-estimator visibility (PP-036), so complementary behaviors exist.

evaluations.evidence: PP-034: As a participant, I want to be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown...
evaluations.rationale: Estimate change is covered together with reveal (PP-033) and earlier change story (PP-041); no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: PP-035: As a participant, I want to be able to see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated...
evaluations.rationale: Prior-estimate visibility is supported by transcript/history/scrolling (PP-017, PP-039) and per-estimator visibility (PP-036), so complementary storage/display exists.

evaluations.evidence: PP-036: As a participant, I want to see who gave what estimates during the current round...
evaluations.rationale: Per-round attribution complements immediate indication (PP-032), reveal (PP-033) and history (PP-017), so complementary capabilities are present.

evaluations.evidence: PP-037: As a participant, I want to be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see...
evaluations.rationale: Timer start is complemented by auto-reset behavior (PP-038) and round events (PP-033), so necessary complementary timer behaviors are present.

evaluations.evidence: PP-038: As a participant, I want to have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate...
evaluations.rationale: Timer reset complements timer start (PP-037) and end-of-draw detection (PP-033), so required complementary capability is present.

evaluations.evidence: PP-039: As a participant, I want to scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds...
evaluations.rationale: Scrolling history complements transcript and export (PP-017/PP-018/PP-019) and prior-estimate viewing (PP-035), so history-related capabilities are complete.

evaluations.evidence: PP-040: As a participant, I want to always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws...
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering is a UI constraint and is compatible with estimate-change/reveal stories (PP-034/PP-033); no missing complementary capability required.

evaluations.evidence: PP-041: As a participant, I want to change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed...
evaluations.rationale: This duplicates/aligns with PP-034 and is complemented by reveal behavior (PP-033); together they cover changing estimates until reveal, so no missing complement.

evaluations.evidence: PP-042: As a participant, I want to have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played...
evaluations.rationale: Thumbnail UI feature complements estimator join/profile (PP-029) and per-estimator visibility (PP-036); no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: PP-043: As a developer, I want to have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards...
evaluations.rationale: Standards/compliance story relates to accessibility/usability (PP-047, PP-050) and error pages (PP-051); no missing complementary developer capabilities required.

evaluations.evidence: PP-044: As a developer, I want to have a list of definitions for commonly used terms...
evaluations.rationale: Glossary/definitions are standalone and complement developer and team understanding; no missing complementary functional capability in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: PP-045: As a developer, I want to have created database indexes...
evaluations.rationale: Performance indexing complements performance requirement (PP-048) and metrics (PP-053); no missing complementary capability evident.

evaluations.evidence: PP-046: As a developer, I want to have the application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2...
evaluations.rationale: Cross-browser support complements standards/accessibility and UI stories (PP-043, PP-047); no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: PP-047: As a developer, I want to have the site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible...
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility complements standards (PP-043) and UI/UX stories; no necessary complementary capability is missing from backlog.

evaluations.evidence: PP-048: As a user, I want to have the application respond quickly to my actions...
evaluations.rationale: Performance requirement is supported by technical stories (database indexing PP-045) and general UX non-functional stories, so complementary technical capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: PP-049: As a user, I want to be able to use Unicode...
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a cross-cutting requirement and is consistent with estimator join and display stories (PP-029, PP-030); no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: PP-050: As a user, I want to see sensible and predictable URLs...
evaluations.rationale: URL design complements transcript/browse features (PP-017, PP-016) and error pages (PP-051); no missing complementary capability required.

evaluations.evidence: PP-051: As a user, I want to have nice error pages when something goes wrong...
evaluations.rationale: Error page story complements standards/accessibility and URL design (PP-043, PP-050); no complementary capability is missing to achieve this feature.

evaluations.evidence: PP-052: As a Researcher, I want results to be stored in a non-identifiable way...
evaluations.rationale: Privacy/anonymization requirement is explicit; transcript/export stories (PP-017/PP-018/PP-019) and account deletion (PP-024) provide complementary capabilities for handling identifiable data, so no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: PP-053: As a Mike, I want to be able to see some metrics on use of the game...
evaluations.rationale: Metrics story is complemented by database/indexing (PP-045) and browsing/exporting features (PP-016/PP-017), so required supporting capabilities are present.
